pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 蛋糕 (dàngāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Friend
   B. Plate
   C. Cake
   D. Candle

2. Which word is pronounced gēge? (1 mark)
   A. 哥哥
   B. 爱
   C. 家
   D. 谁

3. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. 在床卧室。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 床卧室在。
   D. 卧室在床。

4. What does 几 (jǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. Which number, how many
   C. To play
   D. Everybody

5. Which Chinese word means "seven"? (1 mark)
   A. 六 liù
   B. 七 qī
   C. 十 shí
   D. 四 sì

6. What does 祝你生日快乐 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is your birthday
   B. Thank you for the cake
   C. See you tomorrow
   D. Happy birthday to you

7. Which Chinese word means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. 雨 yǔ
   B. 没有 méiyǒu
   C. 刮风 guā fēng
   D. 天气 tiānqì

8. Which character means "big"? (1 mark)
   A. 人
   B. 太
   C. 大
   D. 天

9. In the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马, what does 骂 mà mean? (1 mark)
   A. To ride
   B. To scold
   C. Slow
   D. Mother

10. Read the pinyin: chuáng zài wòshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the television?
   B. The garden is on the right of the house.
   C. The bed is in the bedroom.
   D. The bathroom is beside the garden.

11. Which sentence means "I love you."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我爸爸。
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 那是我弟弟。
   D. 我爱你。

12. Fill the blank: 今天是星期____。 (Today is Wednesday.) (1 mark)
   A. 三
   B. 五
   C. 四
   D. 二

13. Which two characters share 肉? (1 mark)
   A. 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   B. 水 and 牛奶
   C. 茶 and 咖啡
   D. 米饭 and 蛋糕

14. Which punctuation mark is a small circle at the end of a statement? (1 mark)
   A. 。
   B. !
   C. ?
   D. 、

15. Which sentence means "That is my older brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是谁?
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 我爱你。
   D. 那是我哥哥。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother." (2 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake." (2 marks)

18. Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin. (4 marks)

19. What is the main idea of a text and what are details? Give a short example. (3 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 听 and 雨. (2 marks)

21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 一. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Cake
   蛋糕 (dàngāo) means cake.

2. A — 哥哥
   哥哥 is pronounced gēge and means older brother.

3. B — 床在卧室。
   The pattern is thing + 在 + place.

4. B — Which number, how many
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

5. B — 七 qī
   七 (qī) means seven.

6. D — Happy birthday to you
   祝 is to wish, and 生日快乐 is happy birthday.

7. A — 雨 yǔ
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

8. C — 大
   大 dà is big.

9. B — To scold
   骂 is to scold.

10. C — The bed is in the bedroom.
   chuáng zài wòshì. is 床在卧室。, which means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

11. D — 我爱你。
   我爱你。 (wǒ ài nǐ.) means "I love you.".

12. A — 三
   三 is three, so Wednesday.

13. A — 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   牛肉 is beef and 鸡肉 is chicken.

14. A — 。
   That is the Chinese full stop.

15. D — 那是我哥哥。
   那是我哥哥。 (nà shì wǒ gēge.) means "That is my older brother.".

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: The main idea is what the whole text is about, for example "my home". Details are facts that support it, for example "there is a sofa in the living room".
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for main idea, 1 mark for details, 1 mark for the example.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 听: tīng, to listen, to hear. 雨: yǔ, rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 一: yī, one.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
